snippet.title: Good Children Say Grace | Official Trailer | Voiced by Kaori Shimizu | Vocals by Nami Nakagawa
snippet.description:
Official gameplay trailer for Good Children Say Grace.

Voice: Kaori Shimizu (Serial Experiments Lain)
Vocals: Nami Nakagawa (Demon Slayer)
VO Director: Norihiko Hibino (Metal Gear Solid)

My parents sacrificed an orphan to the red egg. She came back home that night. How will the two of us survive the hunger?

Good Children Say Grace is a first-person psychological horror adventure. Eastern European family horror and dark romance filtered through manga-inspired storytelling.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3881920/Good_Children_Say_Grace/

Free Demo: April 2026
Episode 1: June 2026

A collaboration between developer Denis Morozov and writer Milha Vek.

Credits to Delena Martens for the support of the audio composition.
